dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS), germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) immunophenotype by the Hans algorithm.

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IVB. There is a large (9.4 cm) conglomerate retroperitoneal and mesenteric nodal mass with three extranodal sites: right kidney, left adrenal gland, and liver segment VI.

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: Ann Arbor stage IVB. There is a large (9.4 cm) conglomerate retroperitoneal and mesenteric nodal mass with three extranodal sites: right kidney, left adrenal gland, and liver segment VI.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present: drenching night sweats and greater than 10% unintentional weight loss (79 kg to 71 kg over two months).

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rearrangements, so it is not high-grade B-cell lymphoma with double-hit/triple-hit biology; it is also not a double-expressor (BCL2 about 30%, MYC about 20%).

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: it is not high-grade B-cell lymphoma with double-hit/triple-hit biology

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: it is also not a double-expressor (BCL2 about 30%, MYC about 20%)

prog_ipi_high.quote: Standard IPI is 5/5 (age >60, stage III/IV, more than one extranodal site, ECOG performance status 2, elevated LDH).

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: CNS-IPI is also 6/6 (age >60, ECOG >1, stage III/IV, more than one extranodal site, kidney/adrenal involvement, elevated LDH), indicating a high risk of CNS relapse.

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: I recommend curative-intent Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles every 21 days: polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV day 1, rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV day 1, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV day 1, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2

tx_pola_preferred.quote: If polatuzumab is not accessible or not approved, R-CHOP for 6 cycles is the appropriate alternative standard.

mn_non_curative.quote: I recommend curative-intent Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles every 21 days

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use DA-EPOCH-R because of the ECOG 2 status and the burden of continuous-infusion therapy.

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: He has no absolute contraindication to full-dose anthracycline-based therapy, and I would not default to reduced-intensity R-miniCHOP.

cns_risk_addressed.quote: High risk: CNS-IPI 6/6, including kidney and adrenal involvement, multiple extranodal sites, elevated LDH, age >60, ECOG >1, and stage IV.

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I will perform a baseline lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry; MRI brain is indicated if there are neurologic symptoms or if CSF is positive

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: intravenous high-dose methotrexate is relatively unattractive with an eGFR of about 50 mL/min and ECOG 2. If renal function improves to greater than 60 mL/min ... I would reconsider and use 2-3 cycles of intravenous high-dose methotrexate

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: intravenous high-dose methotrexate is relatively unattractive with an eGFR of about 50 mL/min and ECOG 2. If renal function improves to greater than 60 mL/min

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Restage with FDG PET-CT from skull base to mid-thigh about 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted using Lugano 2014/Deauville criteria.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 requires correlation with CT; if a residual mass is present and accessible, biopsy to distinguish residual lymphoma from inflammation or necrosis.

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: Give intravenous hydration and allopurinol 200 mg daily (adjusted for eGFR about 50), monitor potassium, phosphate, calcium, uric acid, and creatinine frequently, and check G6PD before considering rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg for cycle 1 if hyperuricemia persists.

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: check G6PD before considering rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg for cycle 1 if hyperuricemia persists.

sup_gcsf.quote: Use primary G-CSF prophylaxis with pegfilgrastim 6 mg on day 2 because of age >65 and the high-risk regimen.

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen and avoid all NSAIDs because of renal dysfunction, bleeding risk, and fever masking; use acetaminophen and, if needed, a short-acting opioid.

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: Hold metformin around iodinated contrast and during any renal worsening, and monitor glucose closely because prednisone will worsen his HbA1c of 7.4%.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: hepatitis B serologies (HBsAg negative, anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs positive, indicating immunity and no need for antiviral prophylaxis)

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: his performance status is probably worsened by the lymphoma and B symptoms. He has no absolute contraindication to full-dose anthracycline-based therapy, and I would not default to reduced-intensity R-miniCHOP.
